designationHistory.name: Hutton Lake Migratory Bird Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: Established Jan. 28, 1932, as the Hutton Lake Migratory Bird Refuge by Executive Order 5782, signed by President Herbert Hoover.

review.note: Date right; signer was a parsing fragment. Note: EO 5782 calls the land "an addition to the Hutton Lake Migratory Bird Refuge, which is being acquired under" the Migratory Bird Conservation Act, so purchase approval may slightly predate it; FWS treats EO 5782 as the establishing order.
